requirement.description: The IOPort and Direction classes are referenced in tests but not properly imported or exposed in the io module. Tests fail with NameError for 'IOPort' and 'Direction'.
requirement.contract: Ensure IOPort and Direction are properly imported and exposed in the amaranth.lib.io module so that tests can reference them without NameError.

requirement.description: StructLayout and UnionLayout objects are being interpreted as integers causing TypeError when used in constant contexts. This affects several tests related to Const and View operations.
requirement.contract: Implement proper ShapeCastable interface methods in StructLayout and UnionLayout to prevent them from being incorrectly interpreted as integers.

requirement.description: Const class cannot be subclassed according to error message "Subclassing amaranth.hdl._ast.Const is not supported". This prevents certain tests from passing.
requirement.contract: Allow proper inheritance for the Const class or provide an alternative mechanism for the tests to pass.

requirement.description: Error message formatting mismatches between expected and actual messages in several tests. This indicates inconsistency in error message generation.
requirement.contract: Ensure error messages match expected formats for consistency across all error conditions in data layout handling.

requirement.description: The io module lacks proper exports for IOPort and Direction classes which are used throughout the IO tests.
requirement.contract: Update the io module to properly export IOPort and Direction classes from the underlying hdl module.
